verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page says it can post a todo list when a new incident is triggered, which covers the checklist half of the story, though only in one marketing line. Nothing in the evidence shows defined incident roles such as commander or comms lead; escalation policies and on-call routing only decide who gets alerted, not who holds which role. Missing for 10: defined incident roles (commander, comms lead), detailed checklist docs (templates, task assignment, completion tracking), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, incidents carry defined roles (commander, comms lead) and task checklists so response stays coordinated under pressure

citations.quote: Post a todo list when a new incident is triggered.
